name: RouteLocation Source
subtitle: RouteLocation 官方更新來源
description: RouteLocation 官方 SideStore / AltStore 軟體來源。提供經過驗證的未簽名 IPA 發行版本，支援自主簽名與覆蓋更新。

apps.name: RouteLocation
apps.subtitle: iOS DVT 定位與路徑模擬工具
apps.localizedDescription: iOS 本機定位模擬與路線測試工具，支援單點與自訂速度路線模擬，需搭配有效配對檔案及 LocalDevVPN。DDI 為選用的開發者服務元件。Health Sync 為選用功能，步數寫入需相容的 HealthKit 簽名能力。無帳號、分析、遙測、自訂後端或路線上傳。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.24 fixes saved-route map visibility, protects unsaved drafts before playback, and unifies single-point and multi-waypoint paste. Named frequent-route shortcuts make playback faster without starting simulation automatically on paste. / RouteLocation v1.2.24 修正已儲存路線的地圖顯示、保護播放前的未儲存草稿，並統一單點與多航點貼上。具名常用路線快捷播放讓操作更快，貼上本身不會自動啟動模擬。

privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: 用於路線播放時在背景持續傳送開發者位置模擬訊號。
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: 用於讀取 Apple 健康步數權限與狀態。
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: 用於在路線播放時將模擬運動步數寫入 Apple 健康。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.23 adds an optional S2 map visualization, faster saved-route import and playback, clearer route and place workflows, and safer interactive guidance. The S2 grid is display-only and does not affect location simulation. / RouteLocation v1.2.23 新增選用的 S2 地圖視覺圖層，並改善路線匯入與播放、地點操作及互動教學。S2 網格僅供地圖顯示，不影響定位模擬。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.22 adds opt-in interactive tutorials using real controls and actual operation results, retries only temporarily unreadable libraries, and publishes favorite changes only after successful persistence. Ending guidance never restores or changes simulation. / RouteLocation v1.2.22 新增依真實操作結果前進的互動教學，只重試暫時無法讀取的資料庫，收藏變更成功儲存後才更新畫面。結束教學不會恢復或改變模擬。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.21 adds an on-demand bilingual User Guide in Settings, protects unreadable saved data from accidental overwrite, and improves pause reliability, route status visibility, and pairing-import guidance. / RouteLocation v1.2.21 新增設定內的雙語使用指南，保護無法讀取的已儲存資料免遭覆寫，並改善暫停穩定性、路線狀態顯示與配對匯入引導。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.20 improves coordinate-entry reliability: the native Paste control recovers after clipboard or app lifecycle changes, and the coordinate input modal remains stable when the keyboard opens. / RouteLocation v1.2.20 改善座標輸入穩定性：原生「貼上」控制項在剪貼簿或 App 狀態切換後可恢復，且鍵盤彈出時輸入視窗保持穩定。

versions.localizedDescription: RouteLocation v1.2.19: System/Light/Dark appearance; coordinate-only text size; improved Route Player coordinate width; shared favorite ordering; optional best-effort DDI; optional Health Sync capability messaging; bilingual documentation. / RouteLocation v1.2.19：新增外觀與座標文字大小設定、改善路線座標顯示、共用收藏排序、DDI 選用 best-effort 狀態、Health Sync 能力說明與中英文文件。
